description: This file defines the CookieSigner class within the AWS SDK for PHP CloudFront service. It provides methods to create signed cookies for CloudFront authentication, including URL validation and signature generation.

classes.name: CookieSigner
classes.description: A class for signing CloudFront cookies, handling URL validation and signature creation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CookieSigner with a key pair ID and private key.

methods.name: getSignedCookie
methods.description: Creates a signed CloudFront cookie with optional URL, expiration, and policy.

methods.name: validateUrl
methods.description: Validates the URL scheme for signing, ensuring it uses http or https.
